**Issue #2276 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2276: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

<!-- stuck #2242 -->
The technical log's pull request https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/2242 (`patches log`, R1369000) has been open over 2 hours and did not merge itself:

- [rust (test server)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40722925175/job/122938814018)
- [rust](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40722925175/job/122954027422)

Until its entries are on main, the 5 commit(s) it logs are missing from the technical log, and nothing logs them again: a later log holds only what went live after it.

Fix it on a branch from main: add the entries this pull request adds to `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` as they are, each after the entry it follows here, and keep main's, each commit once (`cargo jackioh patches check` holds the file's shape). Keep their `version`, the patch that was live when they went live (R1369000): `cargo jackioh patches log` run again would log them on today's. Fix too any check red here that is red on main. Close this issue with that pull request; the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` then closes this one.

If they are red for a reason outside the repository (CI or Render out of minutes, a spending limit, billing, an account, a runner that never started), no change here fixes it: open the plan with a `**Human required:**` line saying what a person must do, and build nothing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40742580677)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Put on main the five technical-log entries that the stuck log PR #2242 (`patches log: 651ac2e..eba6392`, branch `patches/log-eba6392`, commit 51c90cb4b) adds to `crates/cards/patches/technical.json`. They go in byte for byte, right after the `pr 2230` entry, with their `version` left at `v0.5.0` and every one of main's entries kept, so each commit appears once (R1369000). Also fix the check that turned #2242 red, which is also red on main: `actor::bot_seat::r1452_r744_a_person_who_never_opens_a_bot_match_loses_after_the_grace` in `rust (test server)`, which fails the `rust` summary too. Once this PR merges, `patches-ship.yml`'s watch closes #2242 by itself; this PR closes #2276.

What the planner ran and saw (base 3fbb5fb8c):
- At #2242's head, `cargo test -p jackioh-server` fails exactly one test: that one, panicking at `crates/server/tests/actor/bot_seat.rs:503:58` with "the result". Run alone it fails 20 runs out of 20, both at #2242's head and on main. `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::bot_seat::` on main: 17 passed, 1 failed. One full-suite run on main happened to pass, so the outcome depends on scheduling.
- Cause: #2238 (d7e93b03a) moved the log's fold out of the result's transaction (`read_finished` in `crates/server/src/api/results.rs`, `write_result`). A read of the fake store's tables no longer waits for the write. The test reads `results_get_by_match` as soon as `actor.snapshot().result` is set, while `on_terminal` is still writing; `on_terminal` is awaited inside the same queue task (`crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs`, `run`). #2238 fixed the same race in `crates/server/tests/actor/glitch.rs` (`mod glitchs_swap`, the second `idle(&w).await;` with its `#2213` comment).
- The planner applied the fix below to an untracked copy of main: that test passed 20 runs out of 20, `actor::bot_seat::` passed 18 of 18, and the whole of `cargo test -p jackioh-server` passed (1571 + 628 + 156 + 3 + 2). `cargo jackioh patches check` passed with the five entries in place.
- Nothing in `crates/server` reads `technical.json`. The entries carry no `player` line, so `apps/web/src/wording.test.ts` and the Patch notes page are unaffected. `classify` treats `crates/cards/patches/` and `crates/server/` as App, so no pending fragment is needed.

**Files to touch.**

| Path | new/change | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` | change | Add #2242's 5 entries right after the `"pr": 2230` entry (currently the last one) |
| `crates/server/tests/actor/bot_seat.rs` | change | In `r1452_r744_a_person_who_never_opens_a_bot_match_loses_after_the_grace`, one `actor.idle().await;` with a comment, right after its `wait_until(…).await;` |

Do not touch anything else: not `crates/server/src/` (the race is in the test; the server writes the result inside the queue task that ends the game, as it should), not `crates/cards/patches/patches.json`, no pending fragment, no ruling, no `spec/`, no `.github/`. Do not run `cargo jackioh patches log`: it would log the commits on whatever patch is live today, not the one that was live when they went live (R1369000). Governing: R1369000 (`spec/rulings/R1369000.md`, the technical log's shape) and R105 (versions are opaque). No new ruling is needed: no rules decision is made.

**Steps.**

1. `crates/cards/patches/technical.json`. If the ref exists (`git rev-parse --verify origin/patches/log-eba6392`) and `git diff 51c90cb4b~1 HEAD -- crates/cards/patches/technical.json` prints nothing (main's file is still #2242's base), run `git show 51c90cb4b:crates/cards/patches/technical.json > crates/cards/patches/technical.json`. That reads one file and switches no branch. Otherwise edit by hand. The file ends:
   ```
       "pr": 2230,
       "title": "a replay shows what each of your own choices offered, read-only",
       "kind": "app"
     }
   ```
   Immediately after that `}` (before `]`, or before the next entry if main has gained newer ones), insert exactly the following, with a comma after the `pr 2230` entry's `}`:
   ```json
     {
       "version": "v0.5.0",
       "commit": "c13acd234d80d63ae2f76158204fb241d7ca17ba",
       "pr": 2231,
       "title": "a practice game that earns lets the AI finish every move, so a slow device no longer forfeits the reward",
       "kind": "app"
     },
     {
       "version": "v0.5.0",
       "commit": "152874293d620a1c9e49e517dfbb0627f66d5b0a",
       "pr": 2233,
       "title": "spec check passes again, R2102000's cards line writes its issue as an issue",
       "kind": "internal"
     },
     {
       "version": "v0.5.0",
       "commit": "d81bce9f9af10877b66c5749d0874b432f1ef3e3",
       "pr": 2234,
       "title": "one loading state and one empty state, with the tavern's look",
       "kind": "app"
     },
     {
       "version": "v0.5.0",
       "commit": "c7211eadca7736507a49075c41bcdf7bd1cf251b",
       "pr": 2221,
       "title": "one type scale for the client's text",
       "kind": "app"
     },
     {
       "version": "v0.5.0",
       "commit": "eba63924d1a62b58560b8f0ab8e7c93f59c0357e",
       "pr": 2232,
       "title": "patches ship: v0.5.0",
       "kind": "app"
     }
   ```
   The indentation is two spaces and the file ends with `]` and a newline. Change no other entry. If any of these five commits is already in the file (`grep -c c13acd234d80d63ae2f76158204fb241d7ca17ba crates/cards/patches/technical.json` and so on), stop and add only the ones that are missing. Check with `git diff --stat`: on today's main it is exactly 35 insertions and 0 deletions in this file.

2. `crates/server/tests/actor/bot_seat.rs`, `async fn r1452_r744_a_person_who_never_opens_a_bot_match_loses_after_the_grace` (around line 481). Between
   ```rust
       wait_until(&actor, "the match's end", |actor| {
           actor.snapshot().result.is_some()
       })
       .await;
   ```
   and `let log = log_of(&app).await;`, insert exactly:
   ```rust
       // #2213: the result's write folds the log before its transaction, holding no store lock, so no read
       // of the tables waits it out. This idle queues behind the task that ended the game, so it waits for
       // the write.
       actor.idle().await;
   ```
   The comment must not cite an R-id (`spec check` scans comments). Change nothing else in the file.

**Tests.**

No new test. The existing `r1452_r744_a_person_who_never_opens_a_bot_match_loses_after_the_grace` in `crates/server/tests/actor/bot_seat.rs` is the proof: it fails 20 runs out of 20 on main without step 2 and passes with it. Run:
- `for i in $(seq 1 20); do cargo test -q -p jackioh-server --test server actor::bot_seat::r1452_r744_a_person_who_never_opens_a_bot_match_loses_after_the_grace || echo FAIL; done`: no `FAIL`.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::bot_seat::`: 18 passed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server`: every binary `ok`.
- `cargo jackioh patches check`: exit 0. It holds `technical.json` to its shape: each commit once, versions from `patches.json`.
- `jq -r '.[].commit' crates/cards/patches/technical.json | sort | uniq -d`: prints nothing.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: passes with no fragment.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

**Done when.**
- [ ] `technical.json` holds the 5 entries above, each `v0.5.0`, right after the `pr 2230` entry and in #2242's order, with every entry main had and each commit once.
- [ ] The bot_seat test passes 20 runs out of 20, and `cargo test -p jackioh-server` is green.
- [ ] `patches check`, `catalog check`, `spec check`, rustfmt, clippy, the workspace's cargo tests and the web tests (the harness's list) are green, and `classify --claims` passes.
- [ ] Only the two files above changed.
- [ ] The PR's description says `Closes #2276`.

**Risks.**
- A second log PR merging first: if a newer `patches/log-*` PR lands on main before this one, `technical.json` gains entries after `pr 2230`'s. Keep them, put the five right after `pr 2230`'s entry, and keep each commit once.
- Wrong version: changing `version` or retitling an entry falsifies the record (R1369000). Copy the entries byte for byte.
- Hiding a real bug: the fix only waits for the actor's queue. It weakens no assertion, and the test still asserts the logged `disconnectExpired`, the bot as winner and the freed bot. Do not add `#[ignore]` or a sleep, and do not raise `WAIT_STEPS`.
- Stale build artifacts: the planner ran `cargo clean -p jackioh-server` after testing in a copy. If a first run of the unfixed test passes unexpectedly, run `cargo clean -p jackioh-server` and run it again.
- No effect on determinism, replay or hidden information: no engine, card or client code changes.

**Open questions.**
- The planner has no GitHub access, so it cannot link `rust (test server)` failing on main's own push CI (CLAUDE.md rule 12). The evidence that it is red on main is the local runs above: 20 of 20 failures alone, and 1 failure in the `bot_seat` module, at 3fbb5fb8c. Nothing here points to a cause outside the repository (minutes, billing, a runner), so no person is needed.
- Decisions made: fix the test, not `crates/server/src/`. Rejected: setting the actor's result only after the write lands, which would change production behaviour the spec doesn't ask to change. Also rejected: polling the store inside `wait_until`, whose predicate is synchronous; the repo's own fix for this race in `glitch.rs` is a second `idle`. Copy the entries rather than re-run `patches log`, as the issue says.
````
